newsitem.title: USA: Cincinnati Bell says court favors Ameritech.
newsitem.headline: Cincinnati Bell says court favors Ameritech.

text.p: Cincinnati Bell Inc said on Friday that a Delaware court has granted summary judgment to Ameritech in a suit Cincinnati Bell Inc brought to dissolve their cellular telecommunications partnership.
Cincinnati Bell said it will appeal the ruling to the Delaware Supreme Court.
Cincinnati Bell, a limited partner with a 45 percent interest, filed suit in 1994 against the general partner, Ameritech, the company said.
Cincinnati Bell accused Ameritech with breach of fiduciary duty, conflict of interest, and mismanagement in the cellular partnership covering portions of Ohio and Kentucky.
Ameritech was not immediately available for comment.
Ameritech spokeswoman Marci Grossman said the company is pleased that the court ruled in its favor and that the lawsuit is without merit.
